Package com.smartlostfound.service

Class LostFoundManager

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.service.LostFoundManager
public class LostFoundManager extends Object
Core business logic and service manager for the Smart Lost & Found system. Manages item collections, automated ID sequences, search and filtering pipelines, lifecycle status transitions, analytical statistics, and persistence synchronization.
